subject: one manually seeded candidate and its scoped linkage identity
source_of_truth: Existing manual API plus frozen native scope5578; docs/protocols/backlog-seeding.md is a descriptive draft, not a new ratified provider contract
initial_state: finite source candidate population, target initially linked or unlinked
caller state idle, implicit pending, managed outer or two-phase as specified
existing knowledge track absent or supplied by an earlier committed candidate

operations.name: seed one candidate
operations.synchronization: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE or PG sorted distinct scoped sprint locks, then current event/receipt recheck

operations.name: observe committed or failed candidate
operations.synchronization: after injected fault or actual held-writer wait

consistency.object: per-candidate track/item/link/result preparation and bounded conforming-writer deduplication

assumptions.isolation: SQLite writer serialization; measured default PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED, including independent worker connections
assumptions.clock: existing backend timestamps, no age decision
assumptions.identity: existing repository-local sprint/event mappings and durable generic links; no migration/remapping qualification
assumptions.writers: conforming seed writers; arbitrary SQL or fabricated/deleted receipts outside guarantee

invariants: before-link, after-link, result-preparation and admission failures roll back selected candidate track/item/link state
earlier committed candidates survive a later failure; retry returns only newly seeded items
existing summary/default/actor/linkage and scoped two-target identities are preserved without receipt-ID coercion
initial empty/all-linked calls avoid track creation and preserve pending caller writes
fresh SQLite caller refusal and PG public precommit/managed/two-phase boundaries preserve their stated caller effects
selected event deletion/move/type change and missing sprint are rechecked after an actual writer wait
same-target conforming writers create one item/link and waiting loser skips at default isolation
opposite-direction calls complete in the recorded bounded histories
faults: actual SQL trigger abort before linkage insertion
exception after second candidate linkage insertion
selected event deleted/moved/reclassified under held writer lock
source/target sprint removed under held writer lock
oracles: exact linkage payload and returned item shape/defaults
actual SQLite BEGIN attempt or PG pg_blocking_pids before holder release
pending caller state observed through separate connections
